meeting.title: Platform sync 2026-01-15
meeting.source: synthetic — written for this repo, no real meeting

segments.speaker: Ada Okonjo
segments.text: Morning all. One item today: whether the ingest rewrite ships in this release or the next.

segments.speaker: Bo Lindqvist
segments.text: The rewrite passes on staging but we have no load numbers above ten thousand events a second.

segments.speaker: Ada Okonjo
segments.text: Then it does not ship this release. I would rather be late than page someone at three in the morning.

segments.speaker: Chi Nakamura
segments.text: Agreed. I can run the load test on Thursday if I get the staging cluster to myself.

segments.speaker: Ada Okonjo
segments.text: Take it. Bo, hand Chi the cluster after standup on Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Bo Lindqvist
segments.text: Will do. Do we tell the two pilot customers, or wait until we have the numbers?

segments.speaker: Ada Okonjo
segments.text: Wait. We tell them once Chi's numbers are in, not before. No half-answers to a customer.

segments.speaker: Chi Nakamura
segments.text: One open thing: the old ingest path stays on until when? Nobody has said.

segments.speaker: Ada Okonjo
segments.text: Genuinely open. Bring it back next week with a date attached and we will decide then.

segments.speaker: Bo Lindqvist
segments.text: Last thing, the on-call rota for the release week is still unassigned.

segments.speaker: Ada Okonjo
segments.text: Also open. Let us not decide that with three of us. That is the meeting.
